t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Keep paying attention so that you do not run out of time. The tall brown gnome finds more mushrooms than other gnomes and the taller gnomes in general seem to find more mushrooms than the others.

vb_textbox.text: Keep your fingers on the s and k buttons at all times. Keep focus during the whole of the study as it is easy to forget to click in time. The brown taller gnomes seem to find the most mushrooms. All tall gnomes seem to find more mushrooms and the smaller ones.
